mapper.sql: SELECT l.activity_id AS activity_id, l.enterprise_id AS enterprise_id, SUM(CASE WHEN l.behavior_type = 'scan' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scan_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.behavior_type = 'scan' THEN COALESCE(CAST(l.user_id AS CHAR), CONCAT('v:', IFNULL(l.visitor_key, ''))) END) AS scan_user_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.behavior_type = 'passphrase_verify' AND l.result_status = 'success' THEN COALESCE(CAST(l.user_id AS CHAR), CONCAT('v:', IFNULL(l.visitor_key, ''))) END) AS passphrase_verify_user_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.behavior_type = 'bind' AND l.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(l.user_id AS CHAR) END) AS bind_user_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.behavior_type = 'order' AND l.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(l.user_id AS CHAR) END) AS order_user_count FROM employee_purchase_activity_enterprise_behavior_log l WHERE l.company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.select:
SELECT t.activity_id, SUM(t.scan_count) AS scan_count, SUM(t.scan_user_count) AS scan_user_count, SUM(t.passphrase_verify_user_count) AS passphrase_verify_user_count, SUM(t.bind_user_count) AS bind_user_count, SUM(t.order_user_count) AS order_user_count FROM (
AND l.activity_id IN
#{id}
GROUP BY l.activity_id, l.enterprise_id ) t GROUP BY t.activity_id
